reviews.title: 25 Cent per/litre maximum savings, 100 litres maximum. No way to re-lock
reviews.text:
This  app *used to be* great, the discount is now capped at $0.25 per litre. There is also no way to relock the fuel price, meaning if you lock it and then the price drops in your area, you are stuck locked in with the higher price for seven days. The app used to have no cap and was very helpful, not really anymore. There is now also a limit on the amount of fuel you can buy (100 litres).

Last month I locked in at $2/litre. When petrol rose to $2.50/litre they refused to honour the price and offered a 25 cent discount only instead. Then this week I locked in at $2.59, only to have petrol drop to $2.29. I am now stuck locked in at the $2.59 price even though everywhere it is $2.29. It does not let you re-lock and makes you stuck with the higher price for seven days.

The app is only good if you want to *occasionally* save 25 cents on a 7/11 trip. This means on a purchase of 50 litres of fuel you will save just twelve dollars. Most of the time it's hardly worth the headache as you will need to battle with the lock in system through the app and usually other service stations are cheaper anyway, even without the lock. Get rid of the limit and I'll use your stations again otherwise I'm going back to BP.
